entities.name: Kenjirō Takayanagi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kenjiro Takayanagi  was a Japanese engineer and a pioneer in the development of television and video tape recorders. Although he failed to gain much recognition in the West, he built the world's first all-electronic television receiver, and is referred to as "the father of Japanese television".
